name: dockerignore-check
description: Which files does docker build really send, and which .dockerignore line decides? Exact Docker (BuildKit) rules, no Docker needed.
long_description: check_dockerignore tells, for each path, whether Docker sends it to the build context (so COPY/ADD can see it) and which .dockerignore line decides, with Docker's exact rules: root-only patterns, ** , ! exceptions, last match wins, excluded directories. It also lists the whole context and warns when secrets (.env, .git, keys) are sent. explain_dockerignore explains each line in plain English and flags the classic mistakes (.dockerignore is not .gitignore). Port of Docker's own code (moby/patternmatcher, tonistiigi/fsutil), checked against it on 42,000 random cases. Offline, read-only. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).

tools.name: check_dockerignore
tools.description: Is each path sent to the Docker build context, and which .dockerignore line decides.
